Kaine had made the process seem simple.

The noise of another mind.

Elsbeth.

Squeezing the arm of a young man and saying, I’ll take this one next.
A printed form requesting ten female subjects.

Mandl’s hands pushing a cart with the boy lying on it, the mask and tubes still attached as she wheeled him into an empty room.

she asked.

Test subjects.
